thought.text: The dist is a staging build where the base path points to the staging S3 bucket (as designed for deployment). Next, I'll verify the "single JS file with CSS inlined" format described in the guide, and then stop the dev server.

reasoning_content:
The dist build is a staging build (the script's src points to the staging S3 bucket URL, and the base path is set for bucket deployment — `MISE_ENV=staging` sets the base path to the staging bucket URL). This is as expected for a build artifact meant for upload to the staging bucket root, and it's consistent with the guide's deployment model (the build output references the staging CDN).

This is a deploy-ready artifact, and the dev server has already proven that the app runs locally. The existence of dist corroborates that `mise run build` works.

Let me check whether the dist/index.html bundle is self-contained (IIFE format with CSS inlined, as described in the guide: "a single JavaScript file with CSS inlined"). I'll check the CSS inlining in the staging index.html. The script references https://.../assets/index-BefVnHEI.js — the base path is the staging bucket URL. The guide says the widget is a single JS file with CSS inlined. Let me check whether the JS bundle has CSS embedded (in Vite's IIFE build, CSS is inlined via injected styles). I'll do a quick check.

I should also confirm that the CSS is inlined — let me grep for style injection in the JS.

action.command: cd /workspace/dist; grep -c "createTextNode" assets/index-BefVnHEI.js; grep -o "insertBefore(.*style" assets/index-BefVnHEI.js | head -2; grep -o "style\.sheet" assets/index-BefVnHEI.js | head -2; echo ---; ls assets | wc -l; grep -o '<link rel="stylesheet"[^>]*>' index.html
